features.label: Multiple post rigid support
features.text: Delivers firm cervical immobilization from C1 to C7 with mandibular and occipital pads.

features.label: Articulating chin piece
features.text: Automatically adjusts to patient neutral head position with shorter lateral sides for a precise fit.

features.label: Self-locking height dial
features.text: Pull the dial out to unlock and turn clockwise for fast, one-handed height adjustments.

features.label: Chin-dots fit indicator
features.text: Integrated alignment dots give immediate visual confirmation that the collar is correctly positioned.

features.label: Modular vrtx system
features.text: Designed to step up to CTO or CTLSO configurations with a separate upgrade kit as patient needs change.

features.label: Mr safe and latex free
features.text: Constructed without natural rubber latex and verified MR Safe for clinical and daily use.

features.label: Collar only design
features.text: Includes the collar frame only, allowing for separate purchase of replacement pads when needed.

measurement: This collar is one size adjustable and fits a wide range of adult patient neck anatomies. The self-locking height dial and shorter lateral sides allow more finite adjustments than standard cervical collars. No circumference measurement is required. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
